notes: Produced by veyrix.engine.run_scenario, veyrix.scoring.calculate_score, and veyrix.findings.verified_result.
Regenerate with make demo-snapshot. Do not edit scores, findings, or traces by hand.
The snapshot covers the 12 local scenarios. MCP stdio cases stay on the local worker.

methodology.coverage_denominator: Full adapter catalog snapshotted when the run was queued
limitations: This is a scoped synthetic-fixture assessment, not proof of universal agent security.
The score is an uncalibrated product heuristic, not a probability or external benchmark.
Only matching adapter, policy, engine, runtime versions and scenario scopes can be compared in a trend.
Triage decisions do not alter assessment scores; fresh tests are required to assess a fix.
